English: The homegarden data were collected by dividing the homegarden into four quadrats, the first quadrat stretched from the farmer’s home to 10m, the second quadrat from10m to 20m, the third quadrat from 20m to 30m and the fourth quadrat from 30m to 40m horizontally using farmer’s house as reference depending on the size of the garden.
Luganda: Ebikwata ku mpya yakuŋŋaanyizibwa nga bagabanya empya mu bitundu bina, ekitundu ekisooka kyavanga ku nnyumba y’omulimi okutuuka ku mmita 10, ekitundu ekyokubiri okuva ku mmita 10 okutuuka ku mmita 20, ekitundu ekyokusatu okuva ku mmita 20 okutuuka ku mmita 30 n’ekitundu ekyokuna ne kiva ku mmita 30 okutuuka ku mmita 40 ng’ennyuma y’omulimi y’etandikirwako okusinziira ku bunene bw’oluggya.
Yoruba: Dátà ọgbà-etílé náà jẹ́ gbígbà látàrí pípín àwọn ọgbà-etílé náà sí mẹ́rin,ìpin àkọ́kọ́ wá láti ilé àgbẹ̀ náà sí 10m, ìpí kejì wá láti 10m sí 20m, ìpín kẹta wá láti 20m sí 30m, ìpín kẹrin sì wá láti 30m sí 40m níla pẹ̀tẹ́lẹ̀ tí a bá lo ilé àgbẹ̀ náà gẹ́gẹ́ bíi ìtọ́kasí, èyí tó dá lé bí ọ̀gbà-etílé náà ṣe tóbi sí.
Zulu: Idatha ye-homegarden iqoqwe ngokuhlukanisa i-homegarden ibe ama-quadrats amane, i-quadrat yokuqala yelulekile ukusuka ekhaya lomlimi ukuya ku-10m, i-quadrat yesibili ukusuka ku-10m kuya ku-20m, okwesithathu ukusuka ku-20m kuya ku-30m kanye ne-quadrat yesine ukusuka ku-30m kuya ku-40m ngokuvundlile njengomsusa kuye ngobukhulu bengadi.
Hausa: An tattara bayanan lambunan gidaje ta hanyar raba lambunan gidan gida hudu, na farko ya tashi daga gidan manomi zuwa nisan mita 10, na biyu daga mita 10 zuwa mita 20, na uku daga mita 20 zuwa mita 30 kuma na huɗu daga mita 30 zuwa mita 40 a kwance ta hanyar amfani da gidan manoi a matsayin ma’auni dangane da girman gonar.
Northern Sotho: Datha ya dirapana tša ka gae e kgobokeditšwe ka go arola dirapana tša ka gae ka dikwaterate tše nne, kwaterate ya mathomo e goga go tloga legaeng la molemi go fihla go 10m, kwaterate ya bobedi e tloga go 10m go fihla go 20m, kwaterate ya boraro e tloga go 20m go fihla go 30m gomme kwaterate ya bone e tloga go 30m go fihla go 40m ka go rapama go šomišwa ngwako wa molemi bjalo ka boikgakollo go lebeletšwe bogolo bja tšhengwana.
Amharic: የቤት ውስጥ አትክልት ቦታ መረጃው የተሰበሰበው የአትክልት ቦታዎችን ወደ አራት ካሬዎቸ በመከፋፈል ነበር። የመጀመሪያው ካሬ ከገበሬው ቤት እስከ 10 ሜትር የተዘረጋ ነበር። ሁለተኛው ካሬ ከ10ሜ እስከ 20ሜ ፣ ሶስተኛው ካሬ ከ20ሜ እስከ 30ሜ፣ አራተኛው ካሬ ደግሞ የአትክልት ቦታው መጠን ላይ በመመስረት እና የገበሬውን ቤት እንደ መለኪያ በመጠቀም ከ30ሜ እስከ 40ሜ ወደጎን የተለጠጠ ነበር።

English: From these recorded plants,140 (58.6%) were species utilized for environmental uses, 84 (35%) food crops, 83 (34.7%) medicinal plant species, 39 (16.3%) fodder species, 57 (23.8%) material use plants, 60 (25%) fuel wood species, 50(21%) social use plants and 1 (0.4%) poisonous.

Yoruba: Lára àwọn ewéko tí a ti ṣàkọsílẹ̀ wọn yìí 140 (58.6%) jẹ́ ẹ̀yá tí wọ́n ńí ìlò abáyìíkámu, 84 (35%) àwọn irúgbìn óúnjẹ, 83 (34.7%) ẹ̀ya ewéko ìṣègùn, 39 (16.3%) ẹ̀yà óúnjẹ ẹranko, 57(23.8%) àwọn ewéko ohun èlò, 60 (25%) ẹ̀yà igi elépo-rọ̀bì, 50 (21%) àwọn ewéko ìgbafẹ́ àti 1(0.4%) olóró.

Hausa: Daga cikin waɗannan tsirrai da aka yi rikodi, 140 (58.6%) an yi amfani da su domin amfanin muhalli, 84 (35%) amfanin gona na abinci, 83 (34.7%) nau’o’in tsirrai na magani, 39 (16.3%) nau’o’in kiwo, 57 (23.8%) tsirrai ne masu amfani da kayan aiki, 60 (25%) nau’o’in itace mai mai, 50 (21%) tsirrai ne masu amfani na zamantakewa da kuma 1 (0.4%) masu guba.

Amharic: በኢትዮጵያ ማህበረሰቦች በእርግጠኝነት የአትክልት ቦታዎቻቸው ላይ ምን እንደሚያበቅሉ የተሰራ ብዙም ምርምር የለም።

English: In this study, the researchers wanted to investigate the plants that people in Gozamin district, North West Ethiopia, grew in their gardens and what they used it for.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baayagala okunoonyereza ku bimera abantu mu disitulikiti y'e Gozamin, mu North West Ethiopia, bye balima mu nnimiro zaabwe na kiki kye babikozesa.
Yoruba: Nínú ìwádìí yìí, àwọn aṣèwádìí fẹ́ ṣe ìtọpinpin àwọn ewéko tí àwọn ará agbègbè Gozamin, Àríwá Ìwọ̀-oòrùn Ethiopia, ń gbìn nínú àwọn ọgbà-etílé wọn àti ohun tí wọ́n ń lò wọ́n fún.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi bebefuna ukuphenya ngezitshalo abantu basesifundeni saseGozamin, eNyakatho Ntshonalanga ye-Ethiopia, abazitshala ezingadini zabo nokuthi bayisebenziselani.
Hausa: A cikin wannan binciken, masu binciken sun so su binciki shuke-shuken da mutanen gundumar Gozamin da ke arewa-maso-yammacin Habasha suka shuka a cikin lambuna da kuma abin da suke amfani da su.
Northern Sotho: Ka dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba be ba nyaka go nyakišišiša dimela tšeo badudi ba distriki ya Gozamin, Leboa Bodikela la Ethiopia, ba di lemilego ka dirapaneng tša bona le gore ba be ba di šomišetša eng.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በዚህ ጥናት በሰሜን ምእራብ ኢትዮጵያ በጎዛሚን አውራጃ ሰዎች በአትክልት ቦታዎቻቸው ላይ ስለሚያሳድጓቸው አትክልቶች እና ምን አይነት ጥቅም ላይ እንደሚውሉ መመርመር ፈልገው ነበር።

English: They identified and counted plants in 357 gardens in the area.
Luganda: Baazuula era ne babala ebimera mu nnimiro 357 mu kitundu ekyo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣèdámọ̀, wọ́n sì ka àwọn ewéko ní àwọn ọgbà-etílé 357 ní agbègbè náà.
Zulu: Bahlonze futhi babala izitshalo ezingadini ezingu-357 endaweni.
Hausa: Sun gano kuma sun ƙirga tsirrai a cikin lambuna guda 357 a yankin.
Northern Sotho: Ba hlaotše le go bala dimela ka dirapaneng tše 357 ka tikologong.
Amharic: በአካባቢው ባሉ 357 የአትክልት ቦታዎች አትክልቶችን ለይተው አውጥተዋል እንዲሁም ቆጥረዋል።

English: They also interviewed the community on what they use the plants for.
Luganda: Era baabuuza abantu mu kitundu ku biki bye baakozesanga ebimera ebyo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún ṣe ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò fún àwọn ará àdúgbò náà lóri ohun tí wọ́n ń lo àwọn ewéko náà fún.
Zulu: Baphinde baxoxisana nomphakathi ngokuthi izitshalo bazisebenzisa ngani.
Hausa: Sun kuma yi hira da al’umma a kan abubuwan da suke amfani da tsiron a kai.
Northern Sotho: Ba swere le dipoledišano le badudi mabapi le gore ba šomišetša dimela mabaka afe.
Amharic: የማህበረሰቡ አባላትንም አትክልቶቹን ለምን እንደሚጠቀሙባቸው ቃለ መጠይቅ አድርገውላቸዋል።

English: The researchers found that all the gardens in Gozamin were less than a hectare in size.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakizuula nti ennimiro zonna mu Gozamin zaali teziweza hectare obunene.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà ṣàwárí pé gbogbo àwọn ọgbà-etílé ní Gozamin kéré ju éékà kan lọ.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathola ukuthi zonke izingadi e-Gozamin zazingaphansi kwehektha ngosayizi.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun gano cewa dukkan gonakin da suke Gozamin ba su kai kadada ɗaya ba.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba hweditše le gore diratswana ka moka go la Gozamin di be di fetwa ke hekthara e tee ka bogolo.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በጎዛሚን ያሉ የአትክልት ቦታዎች መጠናቸው ከሄክታር ያነሰ እንደሆነ አግኝተዋል።

English: They collected and identified 238 different plants.
Luganda: Baakuŋŋaanya era ne bazuula ebimera eby’enjawulo 238.
Yoruba: Wọ́n gbà, wọ́n sì ṣèdánimọ̀ fún àwọn ewéko 238 lóríṣiríṣi.
Zulu: Baqoqa futhi bakhomba izitshalo ezihlukene ezingama-238.
Hausa: Sun tattara kuma sun gano shuke-shuke daban-daban har guda 238.
Northern Sotho: Ba kgobokeditše le go hlaola dimela tša go fapafapana tše 238.
Amharic: 238 የተለያዩ አትክልቶችን ለይተው አውጥተው ሰብስበዋል።

English: Most (83%) of the plants were cultivated throughout the year, and only a few (17%) were seasonal.
Luganda: Ebimera ebisinga obungi (83%) byali biwangaazi, so nga bitono (17%) ebyali eby’ekiseera ekimpi.
Yoruba: Púpọ̀ (83%) nínú àwọn ewéko náà ní wọ́n ń gbìn yípo ọdún, díẹ̀ (17%) nínú wọn ló nígbà.
Zulu: Izitshalo eziningi (83%) bezilinywa unyaka wonke, futhi ezimbalwa kuphela (17%) ebezinezinkathi ezithile zonyaka.
Hausa: Ana shuka yawancin (83%) na tsirrai a duk shekara, kuma kaɗan ne kawai (17%) suka kasance na yanayi.
Northern Sotho: Bontši (83%) bja dimela di be di bjalwa ngwaga ka moka, ke fela (17%) tše di bego di bjalwa go ya ka dihla.
Amharic: ከአትክልቶቹ አብዛኞቹ (83%) አመቱን ሙሉ የተሰበሰቡ ሲሆን ከእዚህም የተወሰኑት ብቻ ወቅታዊ(17%) ነበሩ።

English: Their results showed that the community used plants for food, medicine, building, fodder (animal feed), and other cultural uses.
Luganda: Bye baazuula byalaga nti baakozesanga ebimera ng’emmere, eddagala, okuzimba, emmere y’ebisolo, n’emigaso gy’obuwangwa emirala.
Yoruba: Èsì ìwádìí wọn fi hàn pé àdúgbò náà ń lo àwọn ewéko náà fún óúnjẹ, òògùn, ohun ìkọ́lé, óúnjẹ (óúnjẹ ẹranko), àti àwọn ìlo abáṣàmu míràn.
Zulu: Imiphumela yabo ikhombise ukuthi umphakathi ubusebenzisa izitshalo ukudla, imithi, ibhilidi, ifolishi (ukudla kwezilwane), nokunye ukusetshenziswa kwamasiko.
Hausa: Sakamakonsu ya nuna cewa al’ummar sun yi amfani da tsirrai wajen abinci, da magunguna, da gine-gine, da abinci (abincin dabbobi), da sauran al’adu.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo tša bona di bontšhitše gore badudi ba be ba šomiša dimela go tšweletša dijo, dihlare, furu (dijo tša diruiwa), le mabaka a mangwe a setšo.
Amharic: ውጤቶቻቸው እንዳሳዩት ማህበረሰቡ አትክልቶችን ለምግብነት፣ ለመድሃኒትነት መኖ ለመስራት (የእንስሳት ምግብ) እና ለሌሎች ባህላዊ አገልግሎቶች ተጠቅሟል።

English: Most plants served more than one purpose.
Luganda: Ebimera ebisinga byalina emigaso egisukka mu gumu.
Yoruba: Púpọ̀ nínú àwọn ewéko náà ní ju ìlò kan llọ.
Zulu: Izitshalo eziningi zafeza inhloso engaphezu kweyodwa.
Hausa: Yawancin tsirrai sun yi aiki fiye da manufa ɗaya.
Northern Sotho: Bontši bja dimela di be di na le mehola ya go feta o tee.
Amharic: አብዛኞቹ አትክልቶች ከአንድ ባለይ ጥቅም ሰጥተዋል።

English: For example, the Northern large-leaved tree could be used for medicine, decorating, fodder, shade, fencing and other cultural uses.
Luganda: Okugeza, omuti gw’omu Bukiikakkono ogw’ebikoola ebigazi gusobola okukozesebwa ng’eddagala, ekimuli, emmere y’ebisolo, ekisiikirize, olukomera n’emigaso gy’obuwangwa emirala.
Yoruba: Bí àpẹẹrẹ, igi Àtàríwá eléwé-pàlàbá ṣeé lò gẹ́gẹ́ bíi òògùn, ìṣẹ̀ṣọ́, óúnjẹ ẹranko, ìbòji, ìmọdi àti àwọn ìlo abáṣàmu míràn.
Zulu: Isibonelo, isihlahla saseNyakatho esinamaqabunga amakhulu singasetshenziselwa imithi, ukuhlobisa, ifolishi, umthunzi, ukubiya kanye nokunye ukusetshenziswa kwamasiko.
Hausa: Misali, ana iya amfani da bishiya mai manyan ganye ta Arewa domin magani da ado da abinci da inuwa da shinge da kuma sauran abubuwan al'adu.
Northern Sotho: Mohlala, mohlare wa mahlare a magolo wa ka tikologong ya Leboa o be o ka šomišetšwa dihlare, go kgabiša, furu, morithi, go aga legora le mešomo ye mengwe ya setšo.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ የሰሜኑ ባለ ትልቅ ቅጠል ዛፍ ለመድሃኒትት ለማስዋቢያነት፣ ለመኖ፣ ለጥላ፣ ለአጠር እና ለሌሎች ባህላዊ ጥቅሞች ሊያገለግል ይችላል።

English: Over half (59%) of the plants were used for environmental purposes such as fencing, hedges, shade and decorating.
Luganda: Ebimera ebisukka mu kimu kyakubiri (59%) byali bikozesebwa mu bya butonde bwa nsi ng’okukola enkomera, ensalo, ebisiikirize n’ebimuli.
Yoruba: Àwọn ewéko tó ju ààbọ̀ lọ (59%) ní wọ́n ní ìlò abáyìíkámu, àwọn bíi ìmọdi, igbó etílé, ìbòji àti ìṣẹ̀ṣọ́.
Zulu: Izitshalo ezingaphezu kwesigamu (59%) zazisetshenziselwa izinhloso zemvelo njengokubiyela, uthango, umthunzi nokuhlobisa.
Hausa: An yi amfani da fiye da rabin (59%) na tsirrai don dalilai na muhalli kamar shinge da inuwa da kuma kayan ado.
Northern Sotho: Go feta seripagare (59%) sa dimela di šomišetšwe merero ya tša tikologo go swana le go aga legora, morithi le go kgabiša.
Amharic: ከግማሽ በላይ (59%) የሚሆኑት አትክልቶች ለአካባቢ አላማ የዋሉ ሲሆን ለአጥርነት፣ ለመከለያ፣ ለመጠለያ እና ለማስዋቢያነት አገልግለዋል።

English: The researchers said this helped to protect the environment.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti kino kyayamba okukuuma obutonde bw’ensi.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà sọ pé èyí jẹ́ ìrànwọ́ làti dáàbòbò àyíká.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathe lokhu kusiza ukuvikela imvelo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce hakan ya taimaka wajen kare muhalli.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore se se thušitše go šireletša tikologo.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ይሄ አካባቢውን ለመጠበቅ ረድቷል ብለዋል።

English: Fencing plants also helped to safeguard farm produce.
Luganda: Ebimera ebikola enkomera era byayamba okukuuma ebirime.
Yoruba: Àwọn ewéko ìmọdi tún ṣe ìrànwọ́ láti dáàbòbò àwọn èrè oko.
Zulu: Ukubiyela izitshalo nakho kwasiza ekuvikeleni umkhiqizo wasemapulazini.
Hausa: Haka kuma tsirrai masu shinge sun taimaka wajen kiyaye amfanin gona.
Northern Sotho: Dimela tša go aga legora di thušitše le go šireletša ditšweletšwa tša polaseng.
Amharic: አትክልቶችን ማጠር የእርሻ ምርቶችን ለመጠበቅም ረድቷል።

English: Slightly over a third (35%) of the plants were harvested for food, such as fruit, vegetables, cereals and spices.
Luganda: Ebimera ebisukkako katono mu kitundu kimu kyakusatu (35%) byakungulwanga olw’okuliibwa, okugeza ebibala, ebivaavava, ensigo n’ebirungo.
Yoruba: Ìdámẹ́ta ó lé díẹ̀ (35%) nínú àwọn ewéko náà ni wọ́n ń rí ní ìkórè fún óúnjẹ, àwọn bíi èso, àwọn ẹ̀fọ́, àwọn sírìlì àti àwọn èròjà ìdáná.
Zulu: Ngaphezu kwengxenye eyodwa kwezintathu (35%) yezitshalo zavunwa ukuze zidle, njengezithelo, imifino, okusanhlamvu nezinongo.
Hausa: Sama da kashi 35% na tsirrai an girbe su don abinci, kamar ‘ya’yan itace da kayan lambu da hatsi da kuma kayan yaji.
Northern Sotho: Kelo ya ka godingwana sa teetharong (35%) ya dimela tše di bego di bjalelwa go tšweletša dijo, bjalo ka dienywa, merogo, diserele le disepaese.
Amharic: ከአትክልቶቹ ከአንድ ሶስትኛ(35%) ትንሽ የሚበልጠው እንደ ፍራፍሬ፣ አትክልቶች፣ እህሎች እና ቅመሞቹ ላሉ ምግቦች ተሰብስቧል።

English: They however said the gardens in the area mainly provided fruits.
Luganda: Wabula baagamba nti ennimiro mu kitundu kino zaasinga kuvaamu bibala.
Yoruba: Wọ́n pàápàá fìdí ẹ̀ lélẹ̀ pé èso gan-an ni àwọn ọgbà-etílé ní agbègbè náà ń pèsè.
Zulu: Bathe kodwa izingadi ezikule ndawo ikakhulukazi zihlinzeka ngezithelo.
Hausa: Sai dai sun ce gonakin da ksue yankin sun fi samar da ‘ya’yan itatuwa.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjalo, ba boletše gore dirapana ka tikologong di be di tšweletša dienywa kudu.
Amharic: ነገር ግን በአካባቢው ያሉ የአትክልት ቦታዎች በዋነኝነት ፍራፍሬዎችን እንዳመረቱ ተናግረዋል።

English: The researchers said 35% of the plants were used as traditional medicine for human and animal wellbeing, while 21% were used for rituals and religious purposes, smoking, perfumes and baking.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti ebitundu 35% eby’ebimera byakozesebwanga ng’eddagala ly’ekinnansi ery’abantu n’ebisolo, so ng’ebitundu 21% byakozesebwanga olw’okusinza n’eddiini, okufuuweeta, obuwoowo ne mu kufumba.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìi sọ pé 35% àwọn ewéko náà ni wọ́n ń lò fún ògùn ìbílẹ̀ fún ìlera èèyàn àti ẹranko, nígbà tí 21% ṣì jẹ́ lílò fún àwọn ètùtù àti àwọn ohun ajẹmẹ́sìn, fífà bíi sìgá, lọ́fíńdà àti yíyan.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathe u-35% wezitshalo wawusetshenziswa njengemithi yesintu yokuphila kahle kwezilwane nezilwane, kuyilapho u-21% usetshenziselwa imikhuba nezinjongo zenkolo, ukubhema, iziqholo nokubhaka.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce kashi 35% na tsirran ana amfani da su ne a matsayin maganin gargajiya domin jin daɗin mutane da dabbobi, yayin da kashi 21% ana amfani da su ne wajen ayyukan ibada da addini da shan taba da turare da kuma gashi.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore 35% tša dimela di be di šomišwa bjalo ka dihlare tša setšo go thuša go alafa batho le diphoofolo, mola 21% di be di šomišetšwa merero ya ditšo le ya sedumedi, go kgoga motsoko, dinkgišabosana le go paka.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንዳሉት 35% ያህል አትክልቶች ለሰዎች እና እንስሳት ለባህላዊ መድሃኒትነት ጥቅም ላይ የዋሉ ሲሆን፣ 21% ለሃይማኖታዊ እና ስነ ስረአታዊ አላማዎች፣ ለሲጃራ፣ ለሽቶ እና ለመጋገሪያ አገልግዋል።

English: Some plants (17%) were used as fodder to feed cattle, sheep, and donkeys.
Luganda: Ebimera ebimu (17%) byakozesebwa okuliisa ente, endiga, n’endogoyi.
Yoruba: Àwọn ewéko míràn (17%) jẹ́ óúnjẹ láti bọ́ màálù, àgùntàn àti àwọn kẹ́tẹ́kẹ́tẹ́.
Zulu: Ezinye izitshalo (17%) zazisetshenziswa njengefolishi ukondla izinkomo, izimvu nezimbongolo.
Hausa: Wasu shuke-shuke (17%) an yi amfani da su a zaman abinci don ciyar da shanu da tumaki da kuma jakuna.
Northern Sotho: Dimela tše dingwe (17%) di be di šomišwa bjalo ka furu ya go fepa dikgomo, dinku, le ditonki.
Amharic: አንዳንድ አትክልቶች (17%) ከብት፣ በጎች እና አህዮችን ለመመገብ እንደ መኖ አገልግለዋል።

English: Others (24%) served as materials for building, making garden tools, roof thatching and making ropes.
Luganda: Ebirala (24%) byakozesebwanga mu kuzimba, okukolwamu ebikozesebwa mu nnimiro, okusereka n’okukola emigwa.
Yoruba: Àwọn yòókù (24%) jẹ́ àwọn èròjà fún ilé kíkọ́, ṣíṣe àwọn irinṣẹ́ oko, òrùlé ṣíṣe àti okùn ṣíṣe.
Zulu: Abanye (24%) basebenza njengezinto zokwakha, ukwenza amathuluzi asengadini, ukufulela ngotshani nokwenza izintambo.
Hausa: Wasu kuma (24%) sun kasance kayan aikin gini da yin kayan aikin lambu da sarƙar rufin rufi da kuma yin igiya.
Northern Sotho: Tše dingwe (24%) di šomišitšwe bjalo ka didirišwa tša go aga, go dira ditlabela tša ka diratswaneng, go rulela ka bjang le go loga dithapo.
Amharic: ሌሎች (24%) ለግንባታ ለሚያስፈልጉ ቁሳቁሶች፣ ለአትክልት ቦታ መሳሪያዎች፣ ለጣሪያ መጠገኛዎች እና ገመድ ለመስራት አገልግለዋል።

English: Since the majority of the rural populations reportedly used firewood, 25% of plants were used for that.
Luganda: Olw’okuba ng’abantu abasinga mu byalo baakozesanga nku, ebitundu 25% eby’ebimera byakozesebwanga ng’enku.
Yoruba: Nígbà tí púpọ̀ nínú àwọn èèyàn lábúlé ń lo igi ìdánná, 25% àwọn ewéko ní wọ́n ń lò fun.
Zulu: Njengoba iningi labantu basemaphandleni kubikwa ukuthi lisebenzisa izinkuni, ama-25% ezitshalo asetshenziselwa lokho.
Hausa: Tun da yawancin mazauna karkara an ba da rahoton suna yin amfani da itacen wuta, an yi amfani da kashi 25% na tsirrai don haka.
Northern Sotho: Ka ge bontši bja badudi ba dinagamagae go begilwe gore ba be ba šomiša dikgong, 25% tša dimela di be di šomišetšwa morero woo.
Amharic: አብዛኛው የገጠሩ ማህበረሰብ የማገዶ እንጨት ይጠቀማል ተብሎ ሪፖርት ስለተደረገ 25% ያህል አትክልቶች ጥቅም ላይ የዋሉት ለዛ ነበር።

English: The researchers said only one (0.4%) plant was mentioned for poisoning purposes.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti ekika ky’ekimera kimu (0.4%) kye kyagambibwa nti kyakozesebwanga okuwa obutwa.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣẹ̀wádìí sọ pe ewéko kan soso (0.4%) ni wọ́n sọ pé wọ́n ń lò gẹ́gẹ́ bíi májèlé.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathe sinye kuphela isitshalo (0.4%) esishiwo ngenhloso yokufaka ushevu.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce shuka guda ɗaya (0.4%) ce aka ambata don dalilai masu guba.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore ke fela semela se tee (0.4%) se go laeditšwego gore se šomišetšwa merero ya go tšhela mpholo.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንዳሉት አንድ ብቻ (0.4%) አትክልት ለመመረዝ አላማ እንደሚውል ተገልጾ ነበር።

English: They also said the way plants were distributed in the area was influenced by the environment, what people liked to eat, as well as family financial status and business needs.
Luganda: Era baagamba nti engeri ebimera gye byali bisaasaanyeemu mu kitundu yalina ky’ekola ku butonde bw’ensi, ebintu abantu bye baayagalanga okulya, awamu n’embeera y’ebyenfuna by’abantu mu maka n’ebyetaago bya bizineesi.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún sọ pé bí ìpín àwọn ewéko ní agbègbè náà ń wáyé látàrí ipa àyíká, ohun tí àwọn èèyàn fẹ́ràn láti máa jẹ, ipò àwọn ẹbí kọ̀ọ̀kan àti àwọn ohun tí oko-òwọ̀ wọn nílò.
Zulu: Baphinde bathi indlela izitshalo ezisatshalaliswa ngayo endaweni ithonywa yimvelo, izinto ezithandwa abantu, kanye nesimo sezimali somndeni nezidingo zebhizinisi.
Hausa: Har ila yau, sun ce yadda ake rarraba tsirrai a yankin ya shafi muhalli, abin da mutane suke so su ci, da kuma halin kuɗi na iyali da kuma buƙatun kasuwanci.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše le gore tsela yeo dimela di phatlaladitšwego ka tikologong go be go hlohleletšwa ke tikologo, seo batho ba bego ba rata go se ja, gammogo le seemo sa ditšhelete sa ka malapeng le dinyakwa tša kgwebo.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም አትክልቶች በአካባቢው የተከፋፈሉበት ሁኔታ ሰዎች መብላት በሚወዱት እነዲሁም በቤተሰቦች የገንዘብ ሁኔታ እና የንግድ ፍላጎቶች በመሳሰሉ አካባቢዊ ተጽእኖዎች ተደርጎባቸው ነበር።

English: For example, an area called Wenka that had irrigation water and was close to a main town, had many gardens and recorded 130 different plants.
Luganda: Okugeza, ekitundu ekiyitibwa Wenka ekyalimu amazzi g’okufukirira era nga kiri kumpi n’akabuga akakulu, kyalimu ennimiro nnyingi era kyasangibwamu ebimera eby’enjawulo 130.
Yoruba: Bí àpẹẹrẹ, agbègbè kan tó ń jẹ́ Wenka tó ni omi ẹ̀rọ, tó sì súnmọ́ ìgboro, ní ọgbà-etíle púpọ̀, wọ́n sì ṣe ìkọsílẹ̀ ewéko oríṣiríṣi tó tó 130.
Zulu: Ngokwesibonelo, indawo ebizwa ngokuthi iWenka eyayinamanzi okunisela futhi iseduze nedolobha elikhulu, yayinezivande eziningi futhi yaqopha izitshalo ezihlukahlukene ezingu-130.
Hausa: Misali, wani yanki da ake kira Wenka wanda yake da magudanar ban ruwa kuma yana kusa da babban gari, yana da lambuna da yawa kuma yana da tsirrai daban-daban har guda 130.
Northern Sotho: Mohlala, tikologo ye e bitšwago Wenka yeo e bego e na le meetse a go nwešetša ebile e le kgauswi le toropokgolo, e be e na le dirapana tše ntši gomme begile dimela tša go fapafapana tše 130.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ ከዋና ከተማ አካባቢ የሆነው እና የመስኖ ውሃ ያለው ዌንካ የሚባለው አካባቢ ብዙ የአትክልት ቦታዎች ነበሩት እና 130 የተለያዩ አትክልቶችን ሪኮርድ አርጎ ነበር።

English: The Wenka people also grew and supplied fruits and vegetables to the town market.
Luganda: Abantu b’omu Wenka era baalimanga era ne batunda ebimera n’enva endiirwa mu katale k’omu kibuga.
Yoruba: Àwọn ará Wenka sì tún ń gbin, bẹ́ẹ̀ wọ́n ń pèsè àwọn èso àti ẹ̀fọ́ sí ọjà ìgboro.
Zulu: Abantu bakwaWenka nabo babetshala futhi balethe izithelo nemifino emakethe yedolobha.
Hausa: Mutanen Wenka kuma suna shuka da kuma ssamar da kayan marmari da kuma kayan lambu ga kasuwar garin.
Northern Sotho: Badudi ba Wenka le bona ba be ba bjetše ebile ba rekiša dienywa le merogo mmarakeng wa ka toropong.
Amharic: እንዲሁም የዌንካ ሰዎች ፍራፍሬዎችን እና አትክልቶችን ለከተማው ገበያ አቅርበዋል።

English: Lastly, the researchers said most farmers preferred to grow plants that had many uses.
Luganda: Ekisembayo, abanoonyereza baagamba nti abalimi abasinga baasinganga kwagala kulima bimera eby’emigaso emingi.
Yoruba: Nígbẹ̀yìn, àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pé púpọ̀ nínú àwọn àgbẹ̀ fẹ́ràn láti máa gbin àwọn ewéko tó ní ìwúlò púpọ̀.
Zulu: Okokugcina, abacwaningi bathi iningi labalimi lincamela ukutshala izitshalo ezisetshenziswa kakhulu.
Hausa: Daga ƙarshe, masu binciken sun ce yawancin manoma sun fi son shuka tsirrai masu amfani da yawa.
Northern Sotho: Sa mafelelo, banyakišiši ba boletše gore bontši bja balemi ba be ba rata go bjala dimela tše di bego di šomišetšwa mabaka a go fapafapana.
Amharic: በስተመጨረሻ ተመራማሪዎች አብዛኛዎቹ ገበሬዎች ብዙ ጥቅም ያሏቸውን አትክልቶችን ማሳደግ እንደሚመርጡ ተናግረዋል።

English: The researchers said their results confirmed that indeed farmers grew a high number of different types of plants in their gardens, and for different uses.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti bye baazuula byakakasa nti ddala abalimi baalimanga ebika by’ebimera eby’enjawulo mu nnimiro zaabwe, era olw’ensonga ez’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pé èsì ìwádìí wọn fìdí ẹ̀ múlẹ̀ pé, lóòótọ́ àwọn àgbẹ̀ gbin ewéko oríṣiríṣi tó pọ̀ nínú àwọn ọgbà-etílé wọn, èyí fún ìlò ọ̀tọ̀ọ̀tọ̀.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathe imiphumela yabo iqinisekisa ukuthi ngempela abalimi bakhule isibalo esikhulu sezinhlobo ezahlukene zezitshalo ezingadini zabo, kanye nokusetshenziswa okuhlukile.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce sakamakon nasu ya tabbatar da cewa, haƙiƙa manoma suna shuka nau’o’in tsirrai da yawa a cikin lambunansu, da kuma amfani daban-daban.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore dipoelo tša bona di tiišeditše gore ka nnete balemi ba be ba bjala palo ya godimo ya mehuta ye e fapafapanego ya dimela ka dirapaneng tša bona, le go di šomišetša mabaka a go fapafapana.
Amharic: ተመራመሪዎቹ እንዳሉት ውጤቶቻቸው እንደሚያረጋግጡት ገበሬዎች በእርግጥም ከፍተኛ ቁጥር ያላቸው የተለያዩ የአትክልት አይነቶችን ለተለያዩ ጥቅሞች በአትክልት ቦታቸው ላይ ያበቅሉ ነበር።

English: Even though these researchers found that most farmers grew herbs, others researchers had said trees were more common in the area.
Luganda: Newankubadde abanoonyereza bano baakizuula nti abalimi abasinga baalimanga ebimera eby’eddagala, abanoonyereza abalala baagali bagambye nti emiti gye gyali gisinga okusangibwa mu kitundu kino.
Yoruba: Pẹ̀lú bí àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣe ṣàwárí pé púpọ̀ àwọn àgbẹ̀ ń gbin àwọn egbòogi, àwọn aṣèwádìí míràn ti ní àwọn igi gògòrò ló wọ́pọ̀ jù lọ ní agbègbè náà.
Zulu: Nakuba laba bacwaningi bathola ukuthi abalimi abaningi batshala amakhambi, abanye abacwaningi bathi izihlahla zivame kakhulu endaweni.
Hausa: Ko da yake waɗannan masu binciken sun gano cewa yawancin manoma suna shuka ganyayyaki, wasu masu binciken sun ce bishiyoyi sun fi yawa a yankin.
Northern Sotho: Le ge e le gore banyakišiši ba ba lemogile gore bontši bja balemi ba be ba bjala mešunkwane, banyakišiši ba bangwe ba boletše gore mehlare e be e tlwaelegile kudu ka tikologong.
Amharic: እነዚህ ተመራማሪዎች አብዛኛዎቹ ገበሬዎች ቅመማ ቅመሞችን እንደሚያሳድጉ ያገኙ ቢሆንም ሌሎች ተመራማሪዎች እንዳሉት በአካባቢው ዛፎች የበለጠ የተለመዱ ነበሩ።

English: The researchers of this study were based in universities in Ethiopia.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza b’okunoonyereza kuno baali basangibwa mu zi-yunivaasite z’omu Ethiopia.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí fún àkànṣe iṣẹ́ yí wá láti àwọn fásitì ní Ethiopia.
Zulu: Abacwaningi balolu cwaningo bebezinze emanyuvesi ase-Ethiopia.
Hausa: Masu binciken wannan binciken sun kasance ne daga jami'o'i a ƙasar Habasha.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba dinyakišišo tše ba be ba etšwa diyubibesithing go la Ethiopia.
Amharic: የዚህ ጥናት ተመራማሪዎች በኢትዮጵያ ዩንቨርስቲዎች ላይ የተመሰረቱ ነበሩ።
